# Provenance

`136ref.fa.gz` is ported verbatim from FuFiHLA
(`github.com/jingqing-hu/FuFiHLA`, tag `v0.2.3`,
`share/fufihla/dps-dat/136ref.fa.gz`), MIT licensed — see `FUFIHLA_LICENSE`
in this directory for the full notice.

Not re-derived: DESIGN.md notes re-deriving this curatorial artifact "wastes
weeks and yields something slightly different and worse." `resources/anchors/build.py`
adds new anchors alongside it (for genes with no coverage in this set) rather
than modifying it.

Citation (regardless of what the MIT licence compels):

> Jingqing Hu, Qian Qin, Heng Li, Ying Zhou, FuFiHLA: A tool for Full-Field
> HLA typing from long-read data, *Bioinformatics*, 2026, btag231,
> https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btag231
